title: Backswing Slow Coil Tight (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 130bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, slow it down on the way back
Slow on the takeaway, fast on the through
Thats the secret right there

[Verse 1]
Takeaway low and slow, club head wide
Left arm straight, right elbow tucked at the side
Hips turn forty five, shoulders turn ninety
Coil it up tight, son, coil it up mighty

[Pre-Chorus]
One and two on the way back
One two three on the way through
Thats the tempo, son, three to one
Till the work is done

[Chorus]
Backswing slow, coil it tight
Lead arm straight, club shaft right
Top of the swing, club points target
Pause one beat, then bargain

[Verse 2]
Weight shifts to the trail leg, sixty forty hold
Wrists hinge at the top, ninety degrees bold
Lead shoulder under the chin, thats the depth
Coiled like a spring, son, save your breath

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the slower you go the faster you arrive
Dont rush the top, let the coil drive
Three to one tempo, three to one
Thats how the long balls run

[Chorus]
Backswing slow, coil it tight
Lead arm straight, club shaft right
Top of the swing, club points target
Pause one beat, then bargain

[Outro]
Slow back, fast through
Three to one, son, thats the truth
Coil tight, swing free
Thats my boy, listen to me
